name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f app/requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r app/requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed'
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y git-lfs && git lfs install

postAttachCommand.lfs-check: echo '🔍 Checking LFS files...' && git lfs pull || echo '⚠️ LFS pull failed, continuing...'
postAttachCommand.server: echo '🚀 Starting Streamlit...' && streamlit run app/main.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
